Details.title: Details
Details.description: The full returns-and-exchange payload as a JSON string, formatted EXACTLY like this: {"title":"Start a return","orderLabel":"Order #4821 · Mar 2","items":[{"id":"i1","name":"Trailblazer Running Shoe","sku":"TR3-BLK-10","variant":"Size 10 · Black","price":128,"imageUrl":"/resource/asaRetailTrailblazerShoe","category":"shoes"},{"id":"i2","name":"Everyday Merino Crew","sku":"EMC-NVY-M","variant":"Medium · Navy","price":68,"imageUrl":"/resource/asaRetailEverydayMerinoCrew","category":"apparel"}],"reasons":[{"id":"too_small","label":"Too small"},{"id":"changed_mind","label":"Changed my mind"}],"resolutions":[{"id":"refund","kind":"refund","label":"Refund","description":"Back to original payment"}]} Rules: - 'title' (string, optional): heading at the top of the card. Defaults to 'Start a return'. - 'subtitle' (string, optional): a short line under the title, e.g. "Choose what you'd like to send back". - 'orderLabel' (string, optional): the order this return is for, e.g. 'Order #4821 · Mar 2'. Shown next to the subtitle. - 'items' (array, REQUIRED, at least one object): the items the customer can select to send back. Each item MUST have 'id' (string, unique, sent back when the customer confirms) and 'name' (string). Optional per item: 'sku' (string); 'variant' (string, e.g. 'Size 10 · Black'); 'price' (number); 'currency' (string, ISO code, defaults to 'USD'); 'imageUrl' (string, same-origin https URL or '/resource/<Name>'; use the supplied ASA retail static-resource URLs for the sample shoe and shirt); 'category' (string; one of 'apparel','shoes','electronics','beauty','home','grocery','accessories','outdoors','toys'; drives the fallback tile when no image is available). - 'reasons' (array, REQUIRED, at least one object): the reason choices the customer picks from. Each reason MUST have 'id' (string, unique) and 'label' (string), e.g. {"id":"too_small","label":"Too small"}. - 'resolutions' (array, optional): the ways the return can be resolved. Each resolution MUST have 'label' (string) and SHOULD have 'id' (string, unique) and 'kind' (string; one of 'refund','exchange','credit'; defaults to 'refund'). Optional: 'description' (string, short line under the label). When omitted, defaults to Refund / Exchange / Store credit. - 'submitText' (string, optional): label for the confirm button before the item count is appended. Defaults to 'Continue return'. Never emit zero items or zero reasons. Use these EXACT field names — they are the single contract the card reads.
